text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body: 1. Selected the following candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body: Candidate LAB3-68 Candidate LAB3-74 Candidate LAB3-75 Candidate LAB3-91 Candidate LAB3-92 Candidate LAB3-100 Candidate LAB3-101 Candidate LAB3-104 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 27, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
